metaDescription: Kevin argues that public noticing and pressure force powerful people into riskier, costlier moves that expose them further.
summary: Kevin argues that noticing is the public's superpower. He says the more people notice, the more the powerful must resort to increasingly extreme and expensive moves. Kevin acknowledges this means more outlandish actions to deal with, but contends that continued attention and public pressure forces those actions, which in turn only exposes the people behind them further.
